copy.Mevcut parçadan dijital modele ve üretil: Moving from existing part to digital model and manufacturable technical output: when needed, process steps, GD&T and sheet metal DFM connections.
copy.3D tarama, teknik resim ve imalata hazır: We cover the complete workflow from 3D scanning to engineering drawings and manufacturing-ready models, including sheet-metal and tolerancing decisions.
copy.Tersine mühendislik nedir, ne zaman gere: What is reverse engineering and when is it needed?
copy.Tersine mühendislik, elinizde teknik dok: Reverse engineering is producing a measurable digital model and manufacturable technical output based on a physical sample of a part whose technical documentation is missing or outdated. Parts with lost original design data are a common need in scenarios such as supplier change, revision need or improvement of the existing product.
copy.Karar verirken şu soruları netleştirmek: When making a decision, it is necessary to clarify the following questions: Is the part in mass production or a single piece? How critical are material and surface tolerances? Is the existing part worn or modified? These answers determine the scanning method, measurement frequency, and modeling detail level.
copy.Tipik akış dört aşamadan oluşur: hazırlı: The typical flow consists of four stages: preparation and scoping, physical measurement (3D scanning or traditional measurement), CAD modeling and validation, followed by drawing or manufacturing output. The scope is defined in writing from the beginning; Which surfaces are critical, which areas will be referenced and the delivery format (STEP, engineering drawing, sheet metal expansion, etc.) are clarified.
copy.Karmaşık geometrilerde tarama noktası bu: In complex geometries, deviation control is made between the scan point cloud and the surface model. Thickness, bending radius and tolerance classes are also evaluated for sheet metal parts. Project duration depends on part size, detail density, and number of revisions; The clear calendar is shared after the scope is clarified at the first meeting.
copy.Kapsam ve referans yüzeylerin tanımı: Scope and definition of reference surfaces
copy.Teknik resim, sac açılım veya imalat dos: Delivery of engineering drawing, sheet metal expansion or manufacturing file
copy.GD&T ve sac metal tasarımı neden önemli?: Why are GD&T and sheet metal design important?
copy.Tersine mühendislik çıktısı yalnızca geo: The reverse engineering output is not just a geometric model; The tolerance language to be used in assembly and quality control is also required. Geometric tolerancing (GD&T) clarifies functional surfaces and measurement strategy. For sheet metal parts, design-for-manufacturing (DFM) decisions—bend sequence, hole locations, joint type—directly affect the applicability of the model in the field.
copy.Hibrit imalat senaryolarında (eklemeli +: In hybrid manufacturing scenarios (additive + machining), reverse engineering data provides input to both conventional CNC and additive manufacturing planning. Correct scope definition keeps both time and cost under control by avoiding unnecessary detail modeling.
copy.Maliyet ve süre nasıl belirlenir?: How are cost and duration determined?
copy.Tersine mühendislik maliyeti parça karma: Reverse engineering cost varies depending on part complexity, measurement method, desired accuracy class and scope of delivery. A one-piece, low-detail sheet metal element and a multi-surface, tight-tolerance machine part are not considered in the same price range. In every project, we first clarify the scope and then submit a written offer; The first meeting is not binding.
copy.Erken aşamada paylaşmanız gereken bilgil: Information you need to share at an early stage: part photo or sample access, intended use, target material, copy of existing drawing if available, and delivery format expectation. General ranges given without this information may be misleading; Project-based bidding is preferred.

Our Ankara-based team has experience in machinery manufacturing and part types in the defense industry supply chain.
